projects.title: Mini-project: apply Engineering Mechanics (Statics)

Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: the hand calculations agree with the simulation within a stated tolerance.
outcomes: Working model files, the calculation sheet, and a one-page design note (assumptions, units, result).
A short written explanation of Engineering Mechanics (Statics) you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
